field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable or disable this watcher mapping.

field.label: DHCP Source
field.help: Select the DHCP server to watch for leases.

field.label: Hostname Suffix
field.help: Domain suffix for building FQDNs from DHCP hostnames (e.g., home.arpa). Must match an existing primary BIND zone. Reverse zones are not valid here.

field.label: TSIG Key
field.help: TSIG key used to authenticate nsupdate operations against BIND.

field.label: nsupdate Server Address
field.help: IP address of the BIND server for nsupdate (default: 127.0.0.1).

field.label: nsupdate Server Port
field.help: Port of the BIND server for nsupdate. Uses the BIND general port if left empty.
